requirements.statement:
WHEN a line is priced THE SYSTEM SHALL multiply the unit price by the quantity.

Examples:
  line_total(unit_price=4, quantity=3) => 12

tests.name: line totals > multiply the unit price by the quantity [verifies PAR-1~1]
line totals > cost the price of a single unit [verifies PAR-1~1]
line totals > refuse a negative quantity [verifies PAR-1~1]

requirements.statement: WHEN a parcel is shipped to a remote zone THE SYSTEM SHALL add the remote surcharge to the shipping cost.

tests.name: shipping > adds the remote surcharge [verifies PAR-2~1]

requirements.statement: WHEN the quantity of a line is zero or negative THE SYSTEM SHALL reject the line.

tests.name: line totals > refuse a zero quantity [verifies PAR-3~1]
